asset: assets/skate-features/*.glb: 18 procedural skateable features (rails, ledges, ramps, benches) for the pbr look, one node per LOD (<id>_lod0, <id>_lod1 when LOD0 is over 1500 triangles), all on one shared material and trim sheet (textures/skate_trim_*.jpg). features.json is the grind/collision manifest.
tool: Blender 5.2.3 LTS, headless (blender -b -P), glTF 2.0 exporter with Draco (level 7, position 14 bit, normal 10 bit, uv 14 bit)
source: scripts/blender/skate_features.py: every mesh, the trim sheet (color, normal, ORM), and the manifest are built from code (numpy value noise, scratch lines, sheet seams). No photos, scans, generated images, brands, or logos.
prompt: None. The script is the full recipe.
credits: No paid generation credits: Meshy and Tripo not used (session cap 0).
textures: textures/skate_trim_color.jpg (1024x1024), textures/skate_trim_normal.jpg (1024x1024), textures/skate_trim_orm.jpg (512x512): horizontal strips (concrete, waxed concrete edge, granite, painted wood, ramp skin, galvanized, powder black, powder green, bare steel, soil, leaf), tiling in U. The strip table is in features.json.
